# sales
---

<!-- Generated by docs/5-reference/generate.py from the doc comments: do not edit. -->

Package sales is every order the artist makes, whatever the channel: its lines, what shipping was charged and cost, and the margin left. Recording a sale outside a fair takes its units from the catalogue; deleting it gives them back.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `var Periods = []Period{ ... }` | Periods lists every period, in the order the list offers them. |
| `var SelectableChannels = []Channel{ ... }` | SelectableChannels are the channels the order editor offers: every one but AtEvent. |
| `func ChannelWords(channel Channel) string` | ChannelWords is a channel's name, in Spanish. |
| `func DeleteIn(rows storage.Querier, sale Sale, at time.Time) error` | DeleteIn marks a sale deleted inside a transaction; outside fairs its physical units go back. |
| `func InsertIn(rows storage.Querier, sale Sale) error` | InsertIn writes a sale and its lines inside a transaction; outside fairs its physical units leave the catalogue. |
| `func IsLocal(channel Channel) bool` | IsLocal tells whether a channel hands the goods over on the spot, at a fair or in person: its sales never travel, so they are delivered as they are made. |
| `func ItemLabel(productName, variantName string) string` | ItemLabel is "Lámina gato · A4", or only the product's name when the variant has none. |
| `func ProblemWords(problem Problem) string` | ProblemWords is what the artist reads about a problem of a sale. |
| `func SoldAt(day calendar.Date, now time.Time) time.Time` | SoldAt is the moment a sale picked for day is stored at: now when day is today, its noon otherwise. |
| `func StatusWords(status Status) string` | StatusWords is a status's name, in Spanish. |
| `func SummaryWords(sale Sale) string` | SummaryWords is what a sale was and how it ended, as the history writes it: "2 × Gato A5, 1 × Rana · en mano", "3 piezas · entregado", or a project's name alone. |
| `func UnitsSince(sales []Sale, since time.Time) map[string]int` | UnitsSince counts the units of each version, by its ID, that the sales made at or after since sold. |
| `type Channel string` | Channel is where a sale was made. |
| `const AtEvent Channel = "EVENT" ...` | The channels. |
| `type Code string` | Code is a stable name for what went wrong, for programs to check and people to search for. |
| `const CodeNoLines Code = "sales.no-lines" ...` | Error codes of this package. |
| `type Draft struct{ ... }` | Draft is what the order editor saves; names and costs are copied from the catalogue on saving. |
| `type Error struct{ ... }` | Error is a failure of the sales: its code and what it was about. |
| `type Line struct{ ... }` | Line is the units of one variant in a sale. |
| `type LineDraft struct{ ... }` | LineDraft is one line of the order editor. |
| `type Method string` | Method is how a sale was paid. |
| `const Cash Method = "CASH" ...` | The methods. |
| `type Period string` | Period is the stretch of time the sales list shows. |
| `const ThisMonth Period = "THIS_MONTH" ...` | The periods. |
| `type Problem struct{ ... }` | Problem is one reason a sale cannot be recorded or deleted. |
| `func Validate(draft Draft) []Problem` | Validate lists every problem of a draft; none means it can be recorded. |
| `type Query struct{ ... }` | Query is the filters of the sales list; an empty Channel means every channel. |
| `type Sale struct{ ... }` | Sale is an order: one or more lines sold together through a channel. |
| `func Done(sales []Sale) []Sale` | Done keeps the delivered orders, local sales among them: the sales history. |
| `func Filter(sales []Sale, query Query, today calendar.Date, zone *time.Location) []Sale` | Filter keeps the sales of the query's period, counted from today, and channel, newest first. |
| `func FindIn(rows storage.Querier, id string) (sale Sale, found bool, err error)` | FindIn is Find inside a transaction other features are running. |
| `func OfKind(sales []Sale, keeps func(Channel) bool) []Sale` | OfKind keeps the sales whose channel keeps answers yes to. |
| `func OnTheWay(sales []Sale) []Sale` | OnTheWay keeps the orders still to be delivered, oldest first: the next to prepare leads. |
| `type Screens struct{ ... }` | Screens are the orders pages: the board of orders on the way, the sales history with its filters and totals, an order's detail over them, and the order editor. |
| `func NewScreens(store *Store, products *catalogue.Store, newID func() string, ...) *Screens` | NewScreens draws the sales kept in store, picking what they sell from products. |
| `type Status string` | Status is how far an order has travelled. |
| `const ToPrepare Status = "TO_PREPARE" ...` | The statuses, in order. |
| `func StatusOfNew(channel Channel) Status` | StatusOfNew is the status an order starts with: delivered when it is local, to prepare otherwise. |
| `type Store struct{ ... }` | Store keeps the sales in the database. |
| `func NewStore(database *storage.Database, products *catalogue.Store, now func() time.Time, ...) *Store` | NewStore keeps sales in database, finding what they sell in products; tests pass a fixed clock and fixed ids. |
| `type Summary struct{ ... }` | Summary is the totals of a set of sales. |
| `func Summarise(sales []Sale) Summary` | Summarise adds up sales. |
